measuredSpectrum.source: HST CALSPEC spectrum sirius_stis_005.fits: HST/STIS spectrophotometry of Sirius A on the CALSPEC flux scale of Bohlin et al. (2020), AJ 160, 21 (FITS SOURCE keyword)
measuredSpectrum.note: Space spectrophotometry, the CALSPEC flux standard for Sirius. Between 380 and 780 nm every sample is STIS measurement; models are used only outside it. Rows with DATAQUAL 0 are left out.
